dataQuery.sqlStatement: SELECT fcr.request_id SOLICITUD_ID, NVL(fcpt.user_concurrent_program_name, TO_CHAR(fcr.concurrent_program_id)) PROGRAMA, fcr.phase_code FASE, fcr.status_code ESTADO, TO_CHAR(fcr.request_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FECHA_SOLICITUD FROM fnd_concurrent_requests fcr, fnd_concurrent_programs_tl fcpt WHERE fcr.program_application_id = :p_application_id AND fcr.request_date >= TO_DATE(:p_fecha_desde, 'FXYYYY-MM-DD') AND fcr.request_date < TO_DATE(:p_fecha_hasta, 'FXYYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND fcpt.application_id(+) = fcr.program_application_id AND fcpt.concurrent_program_id(+) = fcr.concurrent_program_id AND fcpt.language(+) = :p_language ORDER BY fcr.request_id
